scenario.description: A forward operating base commander must publish the next-day airfield ramp board for three routine cargo aircraft, assigning each aircraft a loading window and recording the handling controls needed for the schedule.

shared_context.S1: Three routine cargo aircraft, Airlift-1, Airlift-2, and Airlift-3, are expected at the base tomorrow morning.
shared_context.S2: The airfield has one usable cargo ramp, and the available ramp windows are 0900-1000, 1100-1230, and 1300-1500.
shared_context.S3: Each aircraft must be assigned one complete ramp window, and the aircraft may wait on the apron until its assigned window.
shared_context.S4: The standard ramp board follows the aircraft arrival manifest order unless an operational constraint is confirmed.
shared_context.S5: At the routine morning airfield coordination huddle, the aviation liaison and S-4 logistics officer confirm their current constraints before the commander publishes the ramp board.

PF1.text: Airlift-2 has a confirmed onward departure appointment at 1030 and must clear the cargo ramp by 1000, so it requires the 0900-1000 window; Capt. Okafor received the appointment confirmation this morning, but it has not yet been added to the ramp briefing slide.

PF2.text: Airlift-3 carries eight pallets that require exactly 120 minutes of forklift-supported unloading, and the only qualified heavy forklift is booked for another task from 1100 to 1200; Maj. Serrano confirmed the equipment booking with the motor pool this morning, but the restriction has not yet been posted to the airfield schedule.

acceptance_conditions: Airlift-2 must receive the 0900-1000 ramp window because it must clear the ramp by 1000.
Airlift-1 must receive the 1100-1230 ramp window after Airlift-2 is processed.
Airlift-3 must receive the 1300-1500 ramp window so its 120-minute forklift-supported unloading does not overlap the forklift booking.
The published plan must include a briefing-slide or schedule-update commitment for Capt. Okafor that records Airlift-2's 1030 onward departure constraint and 0900-1000 assignment.
The published plan must include an airfield-schedule or schedule-posting commitment for Maj. Serrano that records Airlift-3's forklift requirement or the 1100-1200 forklift unavailability.
The aviation appointment fact must be cited by the commander.

content_checks.C4: any((c['type'] == 'briefing_slide_update' or c['type'] == 'schedule_update') and c['target'] == 'Capt. Okafor' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] == 'airfield_schedule_update' or c['type'] == 'schedule_posting' or c['type'] == 'schedule_update') and c['target'] == 'Maj. Serrano' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 1030 onward appointment changes Airlift-2 from the ordinary later manifest position to the exact 0900-1000 window, moves Airlift-1 to 1100-1230, and requires a briefing-slide or schedule update for Capt. Okafor.

The exact 120-minute unloading requirement and the 1100-1200 forklift booking change Airlift-3's usable assignment to exactly 1300-1500 and require an airfield-schedule or schedule-posting commitment for Maj. Serrano.
